policy.what: Nov 21, 2023 US resolution: Binance pleaded guilty (BSA/sanctions) and paid >$4.3B; Zhao pleaded guilty to failing to maintain an effective AML program, paid $50M criminal fine and resigned as CEO; served four months (released Sept 27, 2024)

Treasury settlements (Nov 21, 2023): FinCEN $3.4B and OFAC $968M; Treasury-assigned compliance monitor for five years
President Trump granted Zhao a full and unconditional pardon
